description: Primarily defends but pushes forward to provide width and support attacks via overlaps, staying disciplined in his zone during defensive transitions.
Provides a passing option in build-up and gets further forward to maintain width and support the attack in the final third.
Moves centrally during attacks to act as an extra defensive midfielder, staying disciplined in his zone to support possession.
Tucks inside to act as an extra central defender during attacks, strengthening the defense against counter-attacks.
